# stabilizer　`def.stabilizer`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.stabilizer)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.stabilizer.md)

$G_x$ is a subgroup of $G$; the **kernel** of the action is $\bigcap_{x \in X} G_x$. Orbit–stabilizer gives a bijection $G/G_x \to Gx$, $gG_x \mapsto g \cdot x$. Conjugate points have conjugate stabilizers: $G_{g \cdot x} = g G_x g^{-1}$.

## Notes · **stale**
⭐ The larger the stabilizer, the smaller the orbit; the two are balanced exactly by $|G| = |Gx| \cdot |G_x|$.

⭐ The action is **free** if and only if all stabilizers are trivial (for example, left multiplication); it is **faithful** if and only if the kernel is trivial.
